data.name: About.Text
data.value: Opens Mac-formatted APFS disks in Windows: read-only by default, optional writing (experimental). Open source, GPLv3 license.

data.name: Card.NoVolumes
data.value: This disk has no volumes to show (only macOS internal volumes).

data.name: Consent.NeverList
data.value: • File, folder and disk names, file contents • Serial numbers, identifiers, exact sizes • Passwords, keys, password hints • Computer name and user name; your IP address is not stored

data.name: Consent.SentList
data.value: • Program and Windows version, processor type, interface language • The operation (connect, unlock, writing, safely eject), its result and error code • Technical disk details: connection type (USB, NVMe…), rough size range, number of volumes, encryption type, format features

data.name: Consent.Text
data.value: {0} can automatically send anonymous reports about errors, crashes and successful operations. They show us which disks and situations cause problems, especially with the experimental writing feature. You can see what was sent or turn this off at any time in Settings. Reports are deleted after 18 months.

data.value: This disk is no longer attached.

data.name: List.NoDiskBody
data.value: Plug in your Mac disk; it appears here within a few seconds. Your disk opens read-only first; if you want to write to it, you allow that separately with the button on its card.

data.name: List.ServiceDownBody
data.value: The service that mounts the disks cannot be reached. Try restarting the computer or reinstalling the program.

data.name: List.ServiceDownHeading
data.value: The background service is not running
